# Northwind Telecom — Postpaid plans

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## How postpaid works

A postpaid connection is billed at the end of each monthly cycle for what the plan costs plus
anything used beyond it. A credit limit is set when the connection is opened and is reviewed after
three cycles of on-time payment.

## The plans

| Plan | Monthly rent | Data | Voice | Extra members |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Postpaid 399 | ₹399 | 40 GB | Unlimited | not available |
| Postpaid 699 | ₹699 | 90 GB | Unlimited | 1 add-on SIM |
| Postpaid 999 | ₹999 | 160 GB | Unlimited | 3 add-on SIMs |
| Postpaid 1499 | ₹1,499 | 250 GB | Unlimited | 5 add-on SIMs |

Each add-on SIM costs ₹199 a month and draws from the primary plan's shared data.

## Data rollover

Unused data rolls over into the next cycle, up to a ceiling of 200 GB. Rolled-over data is spent
before the current cycle's allowance. Rollover is forfeited if the plan is changed or the connection
is suspended for non-payment.

## Going over the allowance

Data beyond the allowance and the rollover balance is charged at ₹10 per GB, rounded up to the next
whole gigabyte, and capped at ₹500 per cycle. Beyond the cap the connection continues at 128 kbps
for the rest of the cycle at no further charge.

## Billing cycle and due date

The cycle runs from the date the connection was activated. The bill is generated within two days of
cycle close and is due 15 days later. A payment that arrives after the due date attracts a late fee
of ₹100 or 2% of the outstanding amount, whichever is higher.

## Plan changes

A plan change requested before the 25th of a cycle takes effect from the next cycle; one requested
after the 25th takes effect from the cycle after that. Downgrades are limited to one per quarter.
